facts.fact: The 2023 SNISS yearbook, issued under the health and family ministries, says the sector's planning and statistics cell (CPS/SSDSPF) coordinates the SNISS, which collects, analyses and aggregates national health and social data, with the ministries' technical services and partners; the yearbook was validated at a workshop of 26 to 30 May 2025 and cites DHIS2 as the source of its national tables (for example 958,571 first and 2,144,030 total antenatal visits in 2023).
facts.system: SNISS (Système National d'Information Sanitaire et Social) / DHIS2

systems.tiers: not stated; cited as the source of national and regional aggregates (facility counts, hospitalisations, antenatal visits, population)
